title: Rule ID encoding: variable-length wire format
description: Implement variable-length Rule ID encoding per SCHC spec. Acceptance: encodes/decodes rule IDs correctly, handles all defined rules.
close_reason: Completed against the normative current profile: LICHEN Version 3 fixes Rule IDs at exactly one octet (base SCHC variable widths do not apply). Added shared-vector conformance coverage for Rules 0-7, directional 0x78/0x79, Rule 255, reserved/high-bit legacy-prefix rejection, empty/truncated ID rejection, and literal Rule255 IPv6 behavior. Python SCHC 1268 passed; Ruff/MyPy passed; existing Rust shared-vector consumers 7 passed read-only.
